context: Tests whether the agent pulls complexity downward: absorbs connection lifecycle, serializer setup, and flush/close into the module instead of leaving ordering constraints on callers, while adding batch support.

checklist.name: batch_support_works
checklist.description: Callers can emit multiple events in one call and each event is serialized as one JSON line.

checklist.name: no_required_call_order
checklist.description: Callers no longer need to invoke connect() and set_serializer() before sending; lifecycle and serialization are handled inside the module (constructor defaults, lazy connect, or context manager).

checklist.name: cleanup_internalized
checklist.description: Callers do not manage flush()/close() manually; the module guarantees flush-and-close (context manager, single send function, or equivalent).

checklist.name: no_mode_flags
checklist.description: The solution does not add boolean/mode flag parameters (e.g. batch=True) that select internal behavior branches.

checklist.name: callers_simplified
checklist.description: checkout.py call sites are updated and are shorter or no more complex than before; record_checkout and record_refund no longer duplicate setup/teardown boilerplate.

checklist.name: no_speculative_abstraction
checklist.description: No new classes, layers, or configuration options beyond what the task needs.
